description: Betting lines from VegasInsider's odds screens (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, college football/basketball): every listed game with VI event ID, start time, teams with rotation numbers and, per market (spread, total or moneyline), the opening line, each US sportsbook's line and price (bet365, BetMGM, DraftKings, Caesars, FanDuel, Hard Rock, Fanatics, BetRivers) and VI's consensus. American odds; 'even' is +100. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
